scenario: [LUNI.4.5.1] position 3: an `implicit` unit formula auto-applies at a schema-slot keyword argument to `emit`. `emit PeriodAlert logical period: s.freq` passes a frequency (Hz) to a time (nanosecond) slot, and the program compiles because `hz_period`'s `hz_to_period` applies there.
rules_ds:
unit dimension frequency storage float64 base Hz
unit Hz: frequency

unit formula hz_period inverting implicit:
    hz_to_period(x: Hz): nanosecond  = 1e9 / x
    period_to_hz(x: nanosecond): Hz  = 1e9 / x

schema Signal scope logical:
    freq: Hz key
schema PeriodAlert scope logical:
    period: nanosecond key

rule slow:
    Signal s
->
    emit PeriodAlert logical period: s.freq
